body.statement: For a mixed graph \(G=(V_n,D,B)\), if \(|D|+|B|>\binom n2\), then the linear structural-equation covariance parametrization \(\phi_G\) is generically infinite-to-one.

source.locator: Proposition 2 and the dimension discussion immediately preceding it
source.verbatim_statement: If a mixed graph \(G=(V,D,B)\) with \(V=[m]\) has \(|D|+|B|>\binom{m}{2}\) edges, then \(G\) is HTC-infinite-to-one.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Proposition 2 of the published source.
